title: Focal Point
body_html:
Focal Point

A focal point, also called a Schelling point, is a Nash equilibrium that players coordinate on in the absence of communication because it is natural, special, or salient to them.

MFoGT notes that symmetric equilibria or Pareto-dominating equilibria can act as natural focal points, but focal-point selection may conflict with best-response invariance.

References

  • [MFoGT, Section 4.10.2] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory, references/MechDesign.pdf. Focal point or Schelling point for equilibrium selection.
